notes:
kr8 0.4.13: Agents now answer reliably in DMs, the canvas zooms from 2% to 1600% with pen.dev's keys and a shortcut sheet, first run asks Simple or Advanced, a new Apps page installs pinned optional apps, and the agent card says when a model provider is failing. This release carries six build waves (W1 to W5b) merged since 0.4.12.
